total_model.summary: Model projects 50.1 total points (WAS 23, CIN 27). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 1.8), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 1.2), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 1.2). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
